## User and need

As a [user], I need to [achieve an outcome], so that [benefit].

## Current workflow

How do you handle this today, and where does it fall short?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the experience you want. Include alternatives where helpful.

## Acceptance criteria

List observable outcomes that would demonstrate this works.

## Additional context

Use fictional examples; do not include private customer data or credentials.
